news.headline: Houthis seize Red Sea port and island, threaten Bab el‑Mandeb shipping
news.body: Iran‑aligned Houthi rebels seized the Red Sea port city of Mocha and reached strategic islands near the Bab el‑Mandeb Strait, Reuters reported. The advance threatens a vital shipping corridor and helped drive oil prices above $100 a barrel, raising global supply concerns.
